Fees confirmed 50-55 (manual), booking adds the 3-night minimum, water hookup written. DROP CANDIDATE: standing 3-night minimum + under 1 site in 10 sold nightly (long-stay test 4). Pond value kept on the pond-loop pads (pond ~6 acres). Google 4.8/60.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (standing minimum): every nightly spot the operator sells online carries 'Minimum nights for booking: 3' (Pool #42/#44/#45/#47 read 2026-11-22), no season limit stated - a standing 3+ night minimum.

DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay test 4 / mostly seasonal): the only nightly inventory ever listed is five Pool spots ($50) plus two Pond spots (#136, #138, $55, May-July 2026 captures); the rest are 'Season Long Spots' ($3,200 pool/road, $4,200 pond, 'Please contact us to reserve a seasonal spot'); a slug 'pool-location-78-spots' and site numbers to #138 match the ~150 pads on Esri imagery, essentially all occupied. About 7 of ~150 = under 1 site in 10 nightly. Nightly spots are marked 'Call for Daily Availability'. Five tests: (1) sells nights - yes, a handful; (2) posted nightly rate - yes $50/$55; (3) not residential - seasonal RVs and ~25 rental campers ($125-$300/night); (4) nightly share ~5% - FAIL; (5) no lots sold - none seen.

PRICE GATE: cheapest RV night $50 (Pool spots, 3-night minimum) - at the line, passes; pond spots $55 would not. No Good Sam/member discount posted; gateways.py: none within 40 km; never stayed. Google Maps '3 Sons RV Park' 4.8 stars over 60 reviews, phone +1 605-653-0965. RV Life: unrated.

WATERFRONT (pond kept, reviewer note): the ~2.5 ha fishing pond (about 6 acres by imagery, so near the 5-acre pond/lake line) is ringed by a loop whose inner pads face it across ~20-40 m of open lawn, road on the far side - pond is supported for those pads, but nearly all of them are seasonal ('Pond location (Seasonal): $4200'); only Pond #136/#138 were ever sold by the night ($55, mid-2026) and neither is listed now. If those two stop being nightly, the value is earned only by seasonal sites and should drop to not waterfront.
INCLUSION_EVIDENCE stale: '7 available ... $50.00 and $55.00/night' and 'the park books nightly online' - now five $50 spots with a 3-night minimum and call-for-availability.
